book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Bɨ nan ga ap ñɨg waŋö goƚ au mɨdeia, Jisas gö kamɨŋ la
Hainö pen Juda kai nan kub ñɨŋeb ñɨn u uri a göm, Jisas Jerusalem ara.

Ram mɨnöŋ Jerusalem anɨbu, kaj sipsip dap amɨl apɨl gɨmɨdal adan ramö goƚ au ñɨg waŋö kub ap mɨdeia. Ñɨg waŋö anɨbu Arameik manö löm, Bedesda a gɨmɨdal. Pen ñɨg goƚ mɨhau mɨhau abe ñɨg ubɨŋ aŋ au mɨdeia adö u abe, ram badö mɨlö unbö mamɨd mɨdeia.

Pen nɨbi bɨ nan ga gau iru nöp ap ram bada anɨb gau han mɨdeila. Nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau, rɨmnap amgö we ga, rɨmnap ma naij ga nɨŋöm ajagmɨdal, rɨmnap hañ romaŋ kale böŋ nöp kaƚa ga. Pen ñɨg waŋö u aŋa gɨnab aka göm apöm han mɨdeila.
Ñɨn rɨmnap God ejol ap apöm, ñɨg waŋö u aŋa gö, nɨbi bɨ an nöd ujaŋɨd ñɨg waŋö anɨb yaŋ lugnab u, nɨpe nan nɨhön gɨnab u kamɨŋ lɨmɨdöp.
Pen bɨ ap nan gö, pör nöp um mɨdö, mɨ in ñɨn juöl ado gɨ da kagoƚ böŋ daŋ (38) la, ñɨg waŋö goƚ au dam lɨla mɨdeia.
Jisas bɨ anɨbu nɨŋöm, mɨlö padö anɨgöl mɨdmɨdöp u nɨŋöm, nɨp haga, “Nöp kamɨŋ lɨnɨm, a gɨmön, nɨŋban?” ö ga.
Hageia, bɨ nan ga anɨbu haga, “Bɨ kub. Ñɨg u aŋa gö nɨŋöl gɨ, yɨp ud ñɨg waŋö aŋ yaŋ löl nɨbi bɨ ap mɨdagpal. Yad ñɨg aŋ yaŋ nöd arnam a gɨpin u pen nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap yɨŋɨd nöp nöd arbal,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas pen nɨp haga, “Urakmön, köp ne u wɨnɨg ud aru,” a ga.
Hageia, magö anɨbu nöp nɨp kamɨŋ lö nɨŋöl gɨ, uraköm köp nɨpe u wɨnɨg udöm, ud ara. Pen Jisas bɨ anɨbu nɨp gö kamɨŋ la ñɨn anɨbu, Juda kai God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn kale u me,
Juda bɨ kub gau, bɨ kamɨŋ la anɨbu nɨp hagla, “Ñɨn i God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn hon. Pen ne köp bad ne u ud ajabön u, lo manö hon u wɨhö göp,” a gɨla.
Hageila, haga, “Bɨ yɨp gajɨp kamɨŋ löp u hagöp, ‘Urakmön, köp bad ne u wɨnɨg ud aru,’ a gajɨp u me, ud ajabin,” a ga.
Hageia, hagla, “Bɨ nöp hagö, köp bad wɨnɨg ud ajabön bɨ anɨbu bɨ an?” ö gɨla.
Pen Jisas nɨpe nɨbi bɨ iru mɨdeila aŋ anɨb au agamɨj ara rö, bɨ kamɨŋ la anɨbu, “Bɨ yɨp gajɨp kamɨŋ löp me i,” a göm, hagnɨm rö laga.
Hainö pen, Jisas bɨ anɨbu nɨp God sabe gep ram raul u nɨŋöm haga, “Nöŋ! Nöp kamɨŋ löp. Anɨb u, nan si nan naij gɨmɨdan u arö gɨmön. Wasö u, nöp nan kub yabɨƚ gɨnɨm rö löp,” a ga.
Pen bɨ anɨbu nɨpe ado gɨ amöm, Juda bɨ kub gau kalɨp haga, “Jisas nöp yɨp gajɨp kamɨŋ löp,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia nɨŋöm, God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u gö kamɨŋ la, a göm, Juda bɨ gau Jisas nɨp mulu kal nɨŋla.
Jisas pen kalɨp haga, “Bapi yad u pör nöp wög göl gɨ nöp mɨdöp rö, yad u rö nöp gɨnam,” a ga.

Anɨg hagö, Juda bɨ kub gau, nöd nɨp alun, a göm gasɨ nɨŋla u, uri kƚö yabɨƚ göm nɨŋla. Kale hagla, “Nɨpe God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn hon u rɨb rɨköm, ‘Yad God Ñɨ nɨpe,’ a göp. Anɨb u, God nɨpe mɨdöp rö, yad anɨb unbö rö nöp mɨdpin, a göp,” a gɨla.
Nap haga rö nɨŋöm, Ñɨ nɨpe wög adö ke ke gab
Jisas pen kalɨp haga, “Kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, Ñɨ u nɨpe ke nan ap gɨnɨm rö lagöp; Nap nan gɨnab gau nöp nɨŋöm gɨnab. Anɨb u, Nap gɨnab rö, Ñɨ nɨpe u rö nöp gɨnab.
Nap Ñɨ nɨpe nɨp mɨdmagö löm, nan nɨpe göp göp gau magöŋhalö yamöb. Rɨmnap yamö me, nan ke yabɨƚ gau gö nɨŋmim, kale magöŋhalö aiö gɨnabim.
Pen Nap nɨbi bɨ umbal gau gö urakpal rö, Ñɨ nɨpe u rö nöp, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap, kalɨp gɨnö uraklaŋ, a gɨnab u, gö uraknaböl.
Nɨbi bɨ nɨhön nɨhön gɨpal, gasɨ nɨhön nɨhön nɨŋbal u, Nap nɨŋöm kalɨp manö kub hagagnab; Ñɨ nɨpe nɨp hagö, nɨpe kalɨp magöŋhalö manö kub hagnab.

Anɨb u me, nɨbi bɨ kale Nap hib nɨpe haglö adö arnab u rö, Ñɨ nɨpe hib u abe u rö nöp haglö adö arnab. Pen nɨbi bɨ God Ñɨ nɨpe u nɨp nɨŋöm, hib nɨpe haglö adö aragnab gau, Nap Ñɨ nɨpe hag yua u abe u rö nöp hib haglö adö aragnab.

“Kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, nɨbi bɨ an manö yad u nɨŋöm, Bɨ yɨp hag yuö aunö u nɨp nɨŋ udpal gau, manö kub hag ilön udep adö u nɨŋagnaböl; kale pör mɨdep u hadö udpal. Anɨb u, kale umeb adö u arö göm, pör mɨdep adö u hadö mɨdpal.
Kalöp nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin, ñɨn hain pör abad mɨdpim u söl auab — pen mɨñi hadö auöp i — nɨbi bɨ umöl rö mɨdpal gau, God Ñɨ nɨpe manö hagö, manö anɨbu nɨŋöm nɨŋ udnaböl gau, kamɨŋ lɨnaböl.
Bapi nan gau magöŋhalö kamɨŋ mɨdep iƚ u mɨdöp rö, yad Ñɨ nɨpe u rö nöp kamɨŋ mɨdep iƚ u mɨdpin.
Yad Ñɨ nɨpe pen, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe mɨdpin rö, yɨp hagö, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp manö kub hagem nɨme lɨnabin.
Manö hagabin anɨbu nɨŋmim aiö gagmim: hainö yad hagnö, nɨbi bɨ umlö rɨgöl gɨla gau,
magöŋhalö manö yad nɨŋöm, uraköm, nɨbi bɨ gɨ aij gɨla gau, am yad aip kamɨŋ mɨdeinaböl; pen nɨbi bɨ gɨ naij gɨla gau, uraköm manö kub nɨŋöm pen ilön kub udnaböl.

Pen yad nan nɨhön nɨhön gɨnabin gau, ke nɨŋem gagnabin; Bapi yɨp hagnab rö nöp gɨnabin. Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ manö kub hagem nɨme lɨnabin u, Bapi hagnab rö nɨŋem, kabö göl nöp nɨme lɨnabin. Nɨhön gɨnɨg: yɨp aij gɨnab adö u manö kub hagagnabin. Bɨ yɨp hag yuö aunö Bɨ anɨbu nɨp aij gɨnab adö u nöp gasɨ nɨŋem, manö kub hagem nɨme lɨnabin.
Yad bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpin u nɨŋim, a ga
“Yad ke, ‘God yɨp yuö aunö,’ a gɨbnep u, manö anɨbu kabö rö gagöp a gɨbep.
Pen Bɨ ap halö
yad bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpin u hagöp. Yad nɨŋbin, manö hagöp anɨbu nɨŋö nöp hagöp.
Kale Juda kai bɨ kale rɨmnap hag yube, kale Jon nɨp amöm, yad bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpin, a göm hag nɨŋla u, nɨpe manö nɨŋö nöp kalɨp haga me u.

Jon aka bɨ ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i bɨ ap yad bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpin u hagnab u, yɨp nan kub wasö. Pen kale Jon manö haga u nɨŋmim, manö nɨŋö yabɨƚ a gɨmim nɨŋ udmim, kamɨŋ arnabim a gem, Jon manö yɨp anɨg göl haga, a gɨpin.
Jon manö haga u, nɨpe hapö mɨɫaŋ mailö ñab rö mɨdö, kale manö haga anɨbu mailö rö nɨŋmim, magö pro uƚep magö ap nöp mɨñ mɨñ gɨpe.
“Jon kalöp hag aij ga pen u yɨharɨŋ manö nöp haga. Yad mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i apem, Bapi yɨp gɨmön a ga rö, nan ke yabɨƚ gau gɨpin u me, kale Bapi nɨpe nöp yɨp hag yua u, a gɨmim, waiö yabɨƚ nɨŋbep.
Bapi yɨp hag yua u, nɨpe ke, yad bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpin u, kalöp manö nɨŋö hagab. Pen kale meg magö nɨpe u apdi nɨŋagpim. Nɨpe bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdöp u, a gɨmim nɨŋagpim.
Kale yad bɨ nɨpe hag yua manö yad u nɨŋ udagpim rö, God Manö mɨdmagö kalöp aŋ daŋ mɨdagöp.
“Kale, pör mɨdep udun, a gɨmim, God Manö u amgö lɨ nɨŋ aij gɨpim u pen manö anɨbu, yɨp a göm kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla rö nɨŋmim, pör mɨdep udun, a gɨmim, yɨp auagpim.
“Nɨbi bɨ gau hib yad haglö adö araŋ a gem hagagabin.
Pen kale nɨbi bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpim u hadö nɨŋbin. Kale God nɨp mɨdmagö lagpim u nɨŋem hagabin.
Bapi nɨpe ke yɨp hag yuö aunö u pen yɨp udagpim. Pen bɨ yɨharɨŋ ap gasɨ nɨpe ke nɨŋöm aueinab u, nɨp udnabim.
Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gau hib kale haglö adö areinab u, kalöp aij gɨnab. Pen Bɨ God añɨ nöp mɨdöp u hanɨp nɨŋö, aij gɨnɨm, a gɨmim, gasɨ u nɨŋagpim. Anɨb u, kale ai gɨmim yɨp nɨŋ udnabim?
“Pen Bapi manö yad udöm, kalöp manö kub hagnab, a gɨmim, gasɨ u nɨŋagmim, wasö. Mosɨs hanɨp gɨ ñɨnab a gɨpim u pen Bapi nɨpe Mosɨs manö nɨpe haga manö anɨbu udöm kalöp manö kub hagnab.
Mosɨs nɨpe God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm manö rɨmnap yad bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdpin manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka. Pen Mosɨs manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka manö anɨbu udagpe rö, manö yad hagabin u rö nöp udagnabim.
Mosɨs manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka udagpim rö, kale ai gɨmim manö yad hagabin u udnabim?” ö ga.
